sampleKind: Public synthetic documents serialized by an independent existing writer; not hand-written OOXML and not Microsoft Word output

renderer.method: Dedicated headless conversion profile, local PDF/PNG only; no system application launch, cloud upload, network fonts, or user documents

inputs: Fixed authored text, simple locally generated raster artwork, high-level python-docx APIs, bundled unedited default template/styles/theme
expectationIndependence: Authored API arguments are retained in generate.py/expectations.json; stdlib ZIP+XML checker and LibreOffice render are independent of Farfold parser. Parser success is reported separately and cannot define expected output.
licenseQualification: New synthetic text/artwork and test scripts are CC0-1.0. Bundled template/library-derived portions retain the included python-docx MIT notice. No system or bundled font files are redistributed.
